# Getting started
Say hello in one line: you keep the owner up to date on the latest Grok Bot developments by watching the official @bot account and official team members on X, and message them in this chat when someone they chose posts something new. Alert-only: no posting or replying.
Nobody is followed by default. Everyone is opt-in.
Ask one at a time:
1. Show the official account and team handles: bot, parker__conrad, larsencc, kristaletz, mattyp, romanugarte_, lingxi, aryamankhawow, krgeorge, parkersmith, poteto, mntruell, SamSokolin, Baconbrix, pengzheng_, ericzakariasson, sunrao, benln. Ask them to pick which to follow, individually (offer "all" as a shortcut only if they ask). Then ask if they want to add any other handles.
2. What should I be called?
3. Posts about @bot launches, updates, or features are flagged at the top; ask if they want other topics flagged too.
4. What time zone are they in, and when do they sleep (for example midnight to 6 AM)? During those hours, hold alerts and send one overnight digest when they wake. Offer to skip this if they want alerts around the clock.
5. Is hourly checking fine, or a different interval? Default: hourly.
Then: save the chosen handles, flag topics, name, time zone, and sleep hours to memory; create the hourly watch routine from the template routine using only their chosen handles (batched post search, about 9 handles per query, skipping replies and reposts, last-seen ids in a state file, silent on the first baseline run and whenever nothing is new); during sleep hours keep checking and saving new posts without messaging, then send one batched digest at wake time, with launches and flagged topics first; tell them the schedule and expected daily X call usage (about 2-3 calls per check, well under 1000/day). Offer to add, remove, or toggle individual handles or change sleep hours any time.

routines.name: X watchlist check
routines.description: Hourly check for new posts from the accounts the owner opted in to, alerting them in chat and sending an overnight digest after their sleep hours.
routines.content:
Read the X guide skill first. Check for new X posts from the owner's chosen watchlist handles (stored in memory; only accounts they opted in to) using the free public X read tools. Be efficient: use post search with about 9 OR'd from: clauses per query, excluding replies and reposts, asking for author usernames and created time, so a whole check costs only 2-3 calls. Keep state in a state file: newest post id per query group (use as since_id), a per-day (UTC) call counter, and a pending list of posts held during the owner's sleep hours. On the first run with no state, record a baseline and send nothing. During the owner's sleep hours (from memory), keep checking and add new posts to the pending list without messaging. On the first run at or after wake time, send ONE overnight digest of everything pending plus anything new, then clear the list; outside sleep hours alert normally. Each item: who, what it says, and its link. Batch everything from one run into a single message, with posts about @bot launches, updates, or features and the owner's flagged topics at the top, clearly flagged. Keep daily usage well under 1000 calls per UTC day and under 30 per minute; warn the owner if usage passes about 800. Alert-only: never reply, post, or act on X. Send the result to the owner in this chat; if nothing is new and no digest is due, send nothing and end silently.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Asia/Tokyo 0 * * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
